decisions.reason: As a peripheral accelerator option with only a home-page mention, it is kept as a low-cost option while uncertainty about its strategic value remains high.

The dedicated page signals continued commitment, and although the bio-based binder is outside the core machinery business, its high uncertainty justifies holding the option while costs are manageable.
Close to the established offer and actively promoted with a quantified launch, it has strong strategic fit and unresolved but promising prospects, so it remains a valuable option.
As a mobile recycling plant directly aligned with the firm's core waste-to-resource offer and specifically launched, it has the lowest uncertainty and highest option value, so we keep it.
